YOI-BOI: Release is back on screen: MOD > ATTACK / RELEASE sets how long notes ring after you let go. 75 ms is the original; go lower for tighter notes.
Your DAW keeps its keys: space, Return, Tab, letters and Cmd-Z reach it while you tweak. The arrow keys browse the Library view you're on.
The search box lets go of the keyboard after Return or a click elsewhere. Space no longer clicks the vowel path.
The vowel path shows that it can be clicked to shape it. Bounces render at your project's sample rate.
Locked controls stay put when you change presets (LOAD, arrows or the die). LENGTH and SUB start locked; click a padlock to let presets set them.
THROW-UP: Duplicating a track keeps the preset you picked instead of going back to the default.
Your DAW keeps its keys. The arrow keys step through presets, factory and yours, with the preset box always naming the one you hear.
THROW! can no longer stick on when the window closes mid-hold.
Safer project saves in hosts that save from a background thread.
BACK-SCRATCH: Duplicating a track keeps its preset and pattern instead of going back to the default.
The screen shows your changes while the device is switched off.
Your DAW keeps its keys, Cmd-Z included. The arrow keys browse presets like the screen's arrows, into the selected slot. Escape only cancels what's open.
Long status messages wrap instead of squeezing.
The plug-in's BYPASS and your DAW's bypass are now one switch.
A locked phrase keeps its length and timing when you change presets too; each preset's pattern fits that length.
SHIFTY: DRIVE has four characters on the new DRIVE page: SOFT (the 0.5 drive, exactly as before), TAPE, TUBE and FUZZ.
SMASH: a three-band OTT-style finisher at the end of the chain, with TIME and UP/DOWN. It keeps your level and never clips.
Factory presets re-voiced with the new drives and SMASH; the 24 Classic sounds are untouched. RANDOM picks a model and SMASH too.
Your projects and saved presets from 0.5.4 and older load on SOFT with SMASH off, so they sound exactly as before.
Your DAW keeps its keys, Cmd-Z included. The arrow keys browse the PRESETS list, as filtered, from any page.
Typed values understand units ("1 s", "2 kHz") and vowel names. Tooltips use plain names.
ENERGY HARVESTER: Your DAW keeps its keys. The arrow keys browse presets; they no longer nudge a fader you clicked.
A window resized by dragging its corner keeps its size. Loading a preset keeps your project's sound setting.
The STOP>START mode has one name everywhere.
STUTTER-STEP: New tool row: GATE | SLAP edits the slap sends (with levels), NUDGE moves the groove a step, DOTTED | TRIPLET changes the step length.
32 new grooves: SIMPLE (quarter chugs to triplets) and HATS (8th and 16th hats, shuffles, rolls), plus a HATS family in ROLL FROM.
DRAG MIDI writes dotted and triplet grooves as whole 4/4 bars. The window shows only the device: no dark corners.
Projects and grooves from 0.4.3 and older open and sound exactly as before.
New DRAG MIDI key: drag it onto a MIDI track to drop the groove as a MIDI clip, swing and ghosts included.
Your DAW keeps its keys: Return can't re-roll NEW GROOVE and Tab reaches your DAW. The arrow keys browse grooves, factory then USER.
